meta.description: Load tables for structural_loads: material unit weights (dead) and KDS 41 12 00 occupancy live loads. The agent MAPS the user's words to rows and CONFIRMS the chosen values with the user before computing — this table is a safety input, not a default to apply silently.
meta.sources: Unit weights: customary KDS 41 10 15 / KS design values. Live loads: KDS 41 12 00 표 3.2-1 (category values cross-checked 2026-08-27 against two secondary sources; consult the current code text for sub-categories and reductions).
meta.note: Values are early-design conventions. Project-specific loads (equipment, planters, water depth) override the table; say which row was used in every report.
